assertion_counts_per_test.note: test_schema_authoring_refuses_person_state_role uses pytest.raises, so it has no bare assert; assertion counts are a rough proxy for behavioural depth, not a verdict

classification.name: test_topology_rule_commits_to_exact_result_contract_binding
classification.why: committed == result_contract_ref is trivially true by construction; no tamper case

classification.name: test_result_schemas_are_closed_and_use_only_admitted_objective_roles
classification.why: walks the canary schema against the same ADMITTED_OBJECTIVE_ROLES constant used to build it; would pass even if that constant were wrong

classification.name: test_lawful_positive_topology_result_is_produced
classification.why: real SUPPORTED evaluation, but line 205 `x.v556_object['semantic_family'] if 'semantic_family' in x.v556_object else True` can never fail

classification.name: test_one_lawful_positive_v556_interaction_relation_rule
classification.why: same as test 1 for the interaction canary

classification.name: test_interaction_result_carries_coexisting_relation_array_min_two
classification.why: the 1-relation refusal and the 3-relation SUPPORTED case are genuine; the min_items>=2 claim is read off the self-authored schema

classification.name: test_result_values_outside_closed_schema_vocabulary_are_refused
classification.why: refuses an out-of-enum value and an undeclared extra field

classification.name: test_missing_or_incomplete_authority_refuses_and_never_manufactures
classification.why: no active rule, single participant, wrong role labels

classification.name: test_valid_empty_no_governed_rule_and_missing_authority_manufactures_nothing

classification.name: test_governed_valid_empty_state_still_emits_no_positive_object

classification.name: test_no_actor_state_leaks_into_canary_material
classification.why: substring scan over the two canaries; probes P2/P19 show the MACHINERY does not enforce this, so property 11 is not proven of the substrate

classification.name: test_schema_authoring_refuses_person_state_role
classification.why: proves refusal for author_closed_result_schema only; the binding/rule/registry route is untested and accepts the same material (probe P1)

classification.name: test_no_scalar_pressure_or_strong_noun_is_smuggled
classification.why: substring scan plus a walk of the two canary schemas; probes P9/P19 show the machinery accepts numeric leaves and strong-noun enums, so property 12 is not proven of the substrate

classification.name: test_replay_and_determinants_are_stable_for_exact_governed_inputs
classification.why: x == y, equal replay_key_hash, object id prefix

classification.name: test_attractor_family_stays_supported_but_unfilled
classification.why: line 418 authoring 'V556_SOME_NEW_FAMILY' is refused, which proves the family ceiling; line 416 asserts a MISSPELLED family name ('V556_ATTRACTOR_PREREQUISATE') and is vacuously None

classification.name: test_canary_material_carries_no_real_world_authority_claim
classification.why: snapshot constants; lines 440-441 register two IDENTICAL rules so the duplicate-KEY branch fires and the advertised one-rule-per-family property is never exercised (probe P5b)

thirteen_property_claim.evidence: no governing document enumerates 13 properties: WORKER_COMMISSIONS/PYAT-HQ204-V556-R1/00_COMMISSION.md is 3 lines; 01_SCOPE.md has no numbered list; the HQ204 adjudication ff4f0695, the HQ205 adjudication 0e8d5bcd, H-B d691f9ba and H-E 15e28d61 contain no 13-item property list. The only 13-item list is the candidate's own, mapped 1:1 onto 13 of its own 17 tests.

part_H_verdict: The court counts are correct and reproducible, and the court contains real behavioural proofs (tamper refusal, closed-vocabulary refusal, cardinality floor, negatives, VALID_EMPTY, replay). But at least six of seventeen tests assert constants of material authored by the same tranche, one assertion is a tautology, one is vacuous through a misspelling, one advertised property is exercised against the wrong branch, and two claimed properties (11 and 12) are demonstrated false of the machinery by probes P2 and P19. The 13-property denominator is self-authored.
